name: io.github.pironjulien/nexus-agymail
title: NexusAGYmail
description: Gmail for AI agents through the official API: Google's tool names, sends only after the user's yes.

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_AGYMAIL_HOME
environmentVariables.description: State folder (token, OAuth client) instead of ~/.nexus/nexus-agymail

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_AGYMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Path of your Desktop app OAuth client JSON (otherwise the copy made by `nexus-agymail auth`)

environmentVariables.name: NEXUS_AGYMAIL_PROTECTED
environmentVariables.description: Extra folders whose files are never attached to a draft (os.pathsep-separated)
